newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks fluctuate narrowly after trade data.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks fluctuate narrowly after trade data.

text.p: Tokyo stocks fluctuated narrowly in early Wednesday trade after data showing a surge in Japan's trade surplus failed to drive the yen up against the dollar, brokers said.
They added that the market was in a wait-and-see mood ahead of the Group of Seven (G7) summit later this week.
As of 0014 GMT, the Nikkei average was down 11.90 points or 0.06 percent at 20,581.76. Its June futures rose 20 to 20,620.

"As long as the yen does not shoot to levels near 105 yen to the dollar and linger there, forcing exporters to revise their earnings, there should be no change in the current trend," said Mikio Takada, Nikko Securities general manager.
The Finance Ministry announced earlier that Japan's customs-cleared trade surplus, often a source of friction, more than trebled in May.
